title: ExportReceipt v1
description: A domain-neutral fact-axis record: one export event that actually happened, anchored to exactly one hash-pinned export decision. The fact axis is orthogonal to the permission axis and never writes back into the case package. Receipts carry no supersedes field: facts are not revised; recording errors are handled by governance, not by a core semantic (ADR-0004, decisions 1 and 4).

sha256.description: Mandatory content hash pinning the exact export decision version.

decision.description: The single export decision this export event is anchored to. One-directional and hash-pinned; a receipt never references the case directly, so the permission chain stays traceable.

export_mode.description: The export mode actually used (architecture vocabulary). Graph verification reports a mismatch against the anchored decision's mode as unauthorized_export.

sha256.description: Mandatory content hash binding the exact exported bytes.

locator.description: Optional safe relative path to the artifact. Secondary to the hash, never a replacement. Absolute paths, UNC, drive letters, and '..' are rejected.

artifacts.description: What bytes left. Every artifact is bound to a content hash so the export event stays auditable; an empty artifact list would be an unauditable claim and is rejected.

destination.description: Audit label for where the export went (free text, not a locator). Cross-project destinations are not repository-relative paths; verifiability is carried by artifact content hashes, not by this label.
